brief:
The petroleum authority in Gaza announced Wednesday that three cooking gas trucks entered the enclave, part of a convoy of five trucks that headed toward the border crossing that morning, Shehab Wire reported.

The authority did not specify why two of the five trucks did not complete the crossing or provide details on the distribution of the gas to residents.

title: Gaza receives three of five cooking gas trucks
